matched_discount_comparison: B vs C: same endpoint, Adam initial state, rates, keys, updates

IF2_package_difference: Cuthbert public fit keeps cooling fixed within pass and perturbs before first interval; PFJAX public step has within-pass cooling and uses its native first-observation initialization. Preserve and report; not an identical-algorithm cross-package test.
execution: One case per job, 3 arms same A40, rotate arm order by case mod3; IF2 physically computed once and charged fully to B and C separately in logical method comparison
score: Independent frozen original PyPOMP PF J5000, R36->72->144->288, MCSE<=1 ESS>=10; all failures and low precision retained
failure_rule: No fit retry; preserve last valid parameter/state and failure. Unscorable endpoints retained. Interrupted attempts require audited recovery, not automatic replay.
release_gates: actual CUDA public tests and full-length Dacca checks passed

source hashes and B/C initial state verified
